mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events (event_id, topic, message_key, payload, status, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{topic}, #{messageKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSON), 'NEW', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, topic, message_key AS messageKey, CAST(payload AS CHAR) AS payload, status, created_at AS createdAt, sent_at AS sentAt FROM outbox_events WHERE status = 'NEW' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
